description: Assembles reusable architectural blockouts from an ordered list of simple mesh parts such as boxes, low-poly cylinders, and radial box arrays.

part_types.box: Axis-aligned box with size_m, z_range, and optional center_xy.
part_types.cylinder: Low-poly cylinder with radius_m, segments, z_range, and optional center_xy.
part_types.radial_box_array: Radial repetition of oriented boxes using count, core_radius_m, rib_depth_m, rib_width_m, and z_range.

blender_method: adapter consumes generated mesh vertices and faces; Blender does not assemble source parts
